description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the incognito mode behavior of the keyboard input method. It contains multiple unit tests that verify whether the keyboard correctly switches to incognito mode based on input field properties and user actions.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardIncognitoTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that extends AnySoftKeyboardBaseTest to verify incognito mode activation based on input field properties and user interactions.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenInputFieldRequestsIt
methods.description: Verifies that incognito mode is enabled when the input field requests it via specific EditorInfo actions.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenInputFieldRequestsItWithSendAction
methods.description: Checks incognito activation when the input field requests it with the SEND action.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenPasswordInputFieldNumber
methods.description: Tests incognito mode activation when the input field is a number password field.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenInputFieldNumberButNotPassword
methods.description: Ensures incognito mode is not activated for number fields that are not password fields.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenInputFieldNumberButNotNumberPassword
methods.description: Verifies that incognito mode is not activated for number fields that are not password types.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenPasswordInputField
methods.description: Checks incognito mode activation for text password input fields.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenPasswordInputFieldButNotText
methods.description: Ensures incognito mode is not activated for password fields that are not text-based.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenInputFieldTextButNormal
methods.description: Verifies that incognito mode is not activated for normal text input fields.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenInputFieldTextButNotPassword
methods.description: Ensures incognito mode is not activated for text fields that are not password types.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetIncognitoWhenInputFieldTextButNotTextPassword
methods.description: Checks that incognito mode is not activated for text fields with non-password variations.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenPasswordInputFieldVisible
methods.description: Verifies incognito mode activation when the password field is visible.

methods.name: testSetsIncognitoWhenPasswordInputFieldWeb
methods.description: Checks incognito activation for web password input fields.

methods.name: testClearsIncognitoOnNewFieldAfterMomentary
methods.description: Ensures incognito mode is cleared when switching to a new input field after a momentary one.

methods.name: testClearsIncognitoWhileInMomentaryInputFieldWhenUserRequestsToClear
methods.description: Verifies that user-initiated clearing of incognito mode works during a momentary input field.

methods.name: testDoesNotClearIncognitoOnNewFieldUserRequestIncognito
methods.description: Ensures incognito mode remains active if the user explicitly requests it when switching fields.

methods.name: testDoesNotClearIncognitoOnNewFieldUserRequestIncognitoAfterMomentary
methods.description: Verifies that incognito mode persists after switching fields if the user requested it.

methods.name: testMomentaryIncognitoAfterUserClearsPreviousInputField
methods.description: Checks that incognito mode is reactivated after the user clears a previous input field.
